# Parameter reference

<!-- generated by `python -m galpost.params --markdown`; do not edit by hand -->

Logical parameters are switched on by writing the tag alone on a line. Tags are case-insensitive. Parameters marked **required** must always be given. Besides the tags, a parameter file may contain the blocks `Quantities ... End` and `ListOfGals ... End` (see [the parameter file](parameter_file.md)).

## Files and general settings

| Tag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Snapshot` | string | **required** | Snapshot file to analyse (overridden by -snap on the command line). |
| `Snapdir` | string | empty | Directory containing the snapshot. |
| `Outdir` | string | empty | Output directory (default: current). |
| `Fileflag` | string | empty | Flag inserted in all output file names. |
| `GadgetParamfile` | string | `paramfile.txt` | GADGET parameter file of the simulation (units, periodicity). |
| `MetalsFile` | string | `metals.dat` | List of tracked chemical elements. |
| `Galfile` | string | empty | File with an explicit list of galaxies. |
| `BlockTable` | string | empty | Optional block table describing the snapshot blocks (see gadget_io). |
| `Verbose` | logical | off | More information on stdout. |

## Profiles and galaxy frame

| Tag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SurfaceDensity` | logical | off | Cylindrical bins, surface densities. |
| `VolumeDensity` | logical | off | Spherical bins, volume densities. |
| `GridDensity` | logical | off | Square grid on the disc plane. |
| `NumberOfBins` | int | **required** | Number of bins of the profiles. |
| `RotateGalaxyFrame` | int | **required** | 0: disc in x-y plane; 1 / -1: rotate frame x->y->z / x->z->y. |
| `CmType` | int | **required** | Particle type defining centre and frame; outside 0-5: cold gas + stars (6: cold gas only). |
| `Pressure` | double | **required** | Normalisation of the pressure law for the molecular fraction. |
| `Cut` | string | **required** | Vertical semi-height of the galaxy slice (number in kpc or rmin/rmax/rvir/rgal/ralign); <=0: no cut. |
| `OnlyMultiPhase` | logical | off | Exclude single-phase particles from cold and hot masses. |
| `Htrue` | logical | off | Convert quantities to the true h. |

## Standard galaxy analysis

| Tag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DecompositionMethod` | int | **required** | Bulge/disc decomposition: -1 naive w/o halo, 0 naive, 1 Scannapieco, 2 Murante. |
| `AnalyzeGalaxies` | logical | off | Standard analysis of each galaxy. |
| `AlignWithAngularMomentum` | logical | off | Galaxy frame from the angular momentum instead of the inertia tensor. |
| `AquilaAlignment` | logical | off | Alignment radius = 3 x half-mass radius of CmType particles within rgal. |

## Additional outputs

| Tag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `WriteTables` | logical | off | Append one line per snapshot to tables. |
| `ToFindGalaxy` | logical | off | Write average position, velocity and rotation matrix in code units. |
| `WriteFullCatalog` | logical | off | ASCII catalogue of all particles. |
| `WriteStarCatalog` | logical | off | ASCII catalogue of all stars. |
| `WriteGalaxyCatalog` | logical | off | ASCII catalogues of the particles of each galaxy. |
| `WriteGalaxySnapshot` | logical | off | Snapshot centred on each galaxy, with all blocks of the original. |
| `GalaxySnapshotRadius` | string | — | Radius of the galaxy snapshot (number or rmin/rmax/rgal/rvir/ralign). |
| `GalaxySnapshotInCodeUnits` | logical | off | Write the galaxy snapshot in code units. |
| `CubicGalaxySnapshot` | logical | off | Cubic galaxy snapshot. |
| `AlignGalaxySnapshot` | logical | off | Positions/velocities of the galaxy snapshot in the galaxy frame. |
| `LoadParticleList` | string | empty | Restrict the analysis to these IDs. |
| `WriteParticleList` | logical | off | Write particle ID lists of each galaxy (also used by progenitor tracking). |

## Galaxy selection

| Tag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ReadFofHalos` | logical | off | Galaxies from FoF groups. |
| `FofMinMass` | double | — | Minimum FoF mass (Msun); negative: number of most massive groups. |
| `FofRmin` | double | — | rmin (kpc). |
| `FofRmax` | double | — | rmax (kpc); 0 or 'rvir': virial radius. |
| `FofRgal` | double | — | rgal (kpc); 0: rvir/10. |
| `FofRalign` | double | — | ralign (kpc); 0: rgal. |
| `FofRlog` | logical | off | Logarithmic radial bins. |
| `FofDoNotAlign` | logical | off | Do not align with the galaxy. |
| `ReadSubFindGals` | logical | off | Galaxies from SubFind subhaloes. |
| `SubMinStellarMass` | double | — | Minimum stellar mass (Msun); negative: number of most massive galaxies. |
| `SubRmin` | double | — | rmin (kpc). |
| `SubRmax` | double | — | rmax (kpc); 0: R200c of the parent group. |
| `SubRalign` | double | — | ralign (kpc); 0: rgal. |
| `SubRlog` | logical | off | Logarithmic radial bins. |
| `SubDoNotAlign` | logical | off | Do not align with the galaxy. |
| `SubUsePartAssignment` | logical | off | Use SubFind particle membership instead of apertures. |
| `GroupDir` | string | empty | Directory containing groups_NNN (default: snapshot directory). |
| `TrackFile` | string | empty | Track file written by galpost-track: the galaxy of each snapshot is taken from it (overrides ReadFofHalos / ReadSubFindGals / ListOfGals). |
| `MaxLowResFraction` | double | `-1.0` | Zoom runs: discard galaxies whose low-resolution mass fraction within rvir exceeds this value (<0: no check, as ExtractGalaxies). |
| `LowResTypes` | string | `2,3` | Particle types of low-resolution particles (comma separated). |

## galpost extra analyses

| Tag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ExtraBins` | int | `30` | Number of radial bins of the extra profiles. |
| `ExtraRmax` | string | `rgal` | Outer radius of the extra disc-plane profiles (kpc or rmin/rmax/rvir/rgal/ralign). |
| `ExtraZmax` | double | `5.0` | Vertical semi-thickness (kpc) of the slab used by disc-plane analyses. |
| `ExtraLog` | logical | off | Logarithmic bins for the extra profiles. |
| `KinematicDecomposition` | logical | off | Circularity from the binding energy, eps = jz/jcirc(E) (Abadi et al. 2003), with disc/spheroid masses and histograms (files kindec.*, jhistE.*). |
| `DiscCircularity` | double | `0.7` | Circularity threshold for disc stars. |
| `KappaRot` | logical | off | kappa_rot and kappa_co (Sales et al. 2010, Correa et al. 2017) of stars (in kinematics.*). |
| `KappaRotRadius` | double | `30.0` | Aperture (kpc) for kappa_rot. |
| `StellarPopulations` | logical | off | Radial profiles of stellar age, metallicity, [Fe/H], [O/Fe], [Mg/Fe]; MDF and [O/Fe]-[Fe/H] histogram (files stellarpop.*, mdf.*, ofe_feh.*). |
| `DiscStructure` | logical | off | Stellar surface density, exponential scale length, scale heights, projected half-mass radius (file disc.*). |
| `DiscFitRmin` | string | `auto` | Inner radius (kpc) of the exponential fit; auto: projected half-mass radius. |
| `DiscFitRmax` | string | `auto` | Outer radius (kpc) of the exponential fit; auto: 3 x projected half-mass radius. |
| `KinematicProfiles` | logical | off | Mean rotation, sigma_R, sigma_phi, sigma_z and V/sigma of stars and cold gas (file kinematics.*). |
| `ToomreQ` | logical | off | Toomre Q of cold gas, stars and two-component (file toomre.*). |
| `BarStrength` | logical | off | m=2 Fourier amplitude A2(R), phase, A2max and bar length (file bar.*). |
| `SphericalFlows` | logical | off | Inflow/outflow rates through spherical shells, per component, metal flows and mass loading (file flows.*). |
| `FlowRadii` | string | `0.1,0.25,0.5,1.0` | Shell radii in units of rvir (comma separated). |
| `FlowShellWidth` | double | `0.1` | Shell thickness in units of its radius. |
| `KSRelation` | logical | off | Resolved Kennicutt-Schmidt relation: Sigma_SFR, Sigma_gas, Sigma_H2, depletion times (file ks.*). |
| `MetallicityGradients` | logical | off | 12+log(O/H) of cold gas and [Fe/H] of stars vs radius, with linear fits (file gradients.*). |
| `GradientRmin` | string | `auto` | Inner fit radius (kpc); auto: 0.5 R_e. |
| `GradientRmax` | string | `auto` | Outer fit radius (kpc); auto: 2 R_e. |
| `DustAnalysis` | logical | off | Dust masses (DSTL/DSTS blocks), dust-to-gas and dust-to-metal profiles (file dust.*). |
| `HotHaloAnalysis` | logical | off | Circumgalactic gas between CGMRmin*rvir and rvir: masses by phase, temperature, metallicity, baryon fraction (file cgm.*). |
| `CGMRmin` | double | `0.15` | Inner radius of the CGM in units of rvir. |
| `CentralBH` | logical | off | Black holes within rgal: mass, accretion rate, offset from the centre (file bh.*). |
| `ScalingRelations` | logical | off | One line per galaxy with global quantities for scaling relations (file scaling.*; with WriteTables also table-scaling.gal*). |
| `Satellites` | logical | off | SubFind subhaloes within rvir of the galaxy (file satellites.*; needs a SubFind catalogue in GroupDir). |
| `Maps` | logical | off | Face-on and edge-on surface density maps (PNG + .npy, files map_*). |
| `MapSize` | string | `rgal` | Half side of the maps (kpc or a radius name). |
| `MapPixels` | int | `256` | Pixels per side of the maps. |
| `MapComponents` | string | `stars,cold,hot` | Components of the maps: stars, cold, hot, gas, dm. |
